verdicts.concept: DATE criteria field types and formats
verdicts.claim: DATE criteria supports five date format types: ISODATE, EPOCH_SECONDS, EPOCH_MILLIS, EPOCH_NANOSECONDS, and OBJECT_ID.
verdicts.evidence: Date can be expressed as an ISO-8601-formatted date, a timestamp in UNIX epoch format, or an ObjectId. The UNIX epoch timestamp can be expressed in nanoseconds, milliseconds, or seconds.

verdicts.claim: dataExpirationRule.expireAfterDays bounds are 7 to 9215 days for data deletion from the archive.
verdicts.evidence: Number of days used in the date criteria for nominating documents for deletion. Value must be between 7 and 9215.

verdicts.concept: Partition fields constraints for DATE rules
verdicts.claim: Partition field values are limited to a maximum of 700 characters; documents exceeding this limit are not archived.
verdicts.evidence: The value of a partition field can be up to a maximum of 700 characters. Documents with values exceeding 700 characters are not archived.

verdicts.concept: Partition fields constraints for DATE rules
verdicts.claim: Maximum of three partition fields are allowed: the date field plus up to two additional commonly-queried fields.
verdicts.evidence: The date field is in the first position of the partition by default for the Date Match criteria.
